R1010.note: Allowlist regex's \s includes newline, so a %0A-encoded header value decodes to a literal newline that sh -c treats as a statement separator, bypassing the filter; the 400-on-reject restriction is disclosed.

R1011.note: Replaces default-ECB with CBC/GCM plus a random IV/nonce prepended to the ciphertext, an openly-stated format change a key holder can still decrypt, satisfying the stated contract.

R1012.note: Parameterizes both uid and street via ctx.search's filterArgs, which the JNDI API documents as RFC-4515-escaped; semantics unchanged.

R1013.note: Parameterizes both tenantId and beforeDate closing the injection, but adds no date validation, so a malformed beforeDate still surfaces as an unhandled SqlException rather than the contract's required request-validation failure (only vaguely gestured at, not implemented).

R1014.note: Standard ? placeholder plus variadic arg to sqlx.Select, preserves query semantics.

R1015.note: GUID filename plus extension check correctly closes the traversal, but the shown fix stops before the trailing return statement, which still echoes the client-supplied file.FileName instead of the actual stored name - an undisclosed inconsistency.

R1016.note: escapeshellarg on both requestedName and target mirrors the file's existing safe pattern; return/output-array contract unaffected.

R1017.note: ldapjs EqualityFilter is the library's documented safe filter-object API and applies RFC-4515 escaping; same attribute/value semantics preserved.

R1018.note: Canonical bounds check before write; only out-of-range attacker offsets are skipped, never a valid position, so no legitimate edit is dropped.

R1019.note: Restores signature verification correctly, but only catches InvalidSignatureError/DecodeError - jwt.ExpiredSignatureError is a sibling exception, not a subclass of either, so an expired token now raises unhandled, undisclosed 500 instead of a clean 401.

R1020.note: Moves the %...% wildcard construction into the bound parameter, preserving LIKE substring semantics exactly per the stated contract.

R1021.note: Array form to proc_open avoids the shell entirely and keeps the -- end-of-options marker, closing both shell-metacharacter and flag-injection variants.

R1022.note: redis-py .hset() frames field/value as separate RESP arguments and preserves the original class's constructor/method signature so callers are unaffected.

R1023.note: OWASP Encoder forHtml() is correct for the HTML-body context and preserves the greeting text/behavior for legitimate names.

R1024.note: Allowlist enforces the four approved sort modes per contract, but any other sort value is silently redirected to a default rather than rejected - disclosed as a known gap ('whitelist should be expanded').

R1025.note: Canonical erase-and-reassign idiom preserves order and visits every element exactly once, matching the contract.

R1026.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 at both concatenation points closes the XSS with no behavior change for legitimate content.
